name: clean_refactor
description: Type hints, a docstring and a clearer range check; behaviour is unchanged.

input.diff:
diff --git a/net/ports.py b/net/ports.py
--- a/net/ports.py
+++ b/net/ports.py
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
-def parse_port(value):
+def parse_port(value: str) -> int:
+    """Parse a TCP port number and check that it is in the valid range.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: if the value is not an integer between 1 and 65535.
+    """
     port = int(value)
-    if port < 1 or port > 65535:
-        raise ValueError("port out of range")
+    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
+        raise ValueError(f"port out of range: {port}")
     return port
